import: In Resolve use File > Import > Timeline and pick the .fcpxml.

Leave 'Import source clips' on: it links each clip to its media file. A scripted import needs importSourceClips: True with sourceClipsPath (the folder holding the media); with it off the clips come in unlinked (Media Offline).
A clip links only when its asset starts at its file's start timecode (Source.start_timecode); the notes name every source without one.

A 9:16 short (any size other than the project's): importing it changes the project's resolution, which flips every timeline without custom settings. Import a short into a project of its own, or a timeline with custom settings, and tick 'Use sizing information' and 'Automatically set project settings' (the import otherwise ignores the FCPXML size: a 9:16 short came in at 1920x1080).
Audio crossfades and fades arrive as volume keyframes on overlapping clips; replace them with Fairlight crossfades by hand if preferred.
